name: Mii head replacement state
notes: Mii head state is separate from the selected character ID.
For normal characters this value has been observed/documented as 0.
When enabled, value 1 appears to replace the character head with a Mii head.
Selecting the Mii character likely sets this to 1, but that still needs a runtime confirmation.
open_questions: Confirm whether selecting CHAR_ID_MII always sets this value to 1.
Find the function that commits Mii head state alongside selected character and costume.
Determine whether values other than 0 and 1 select Mii head variants or are invalid.
